ns2:section.sectionText: Animal Biology, 4 hours. This course covers introductory zoological concepts of animal anatomy, physiology, behavior, genetics and evolution. In this lab section we will explore concepts of animal anatomy, physiology, behavior, genetics and evolution, and integrate the lab topic with each week's lecture material, emphasizing current research and relevant health issues. First year Discovery Program course. Registration restricted to freshman. Students should only enroll in one Discovery course.
